findings:
🟠 [predicate-parity-false-green] MUST-FIX The parity test never proves blind-capable runners reach the stub: it only checks that the containment error text is absent, so any unrelated precondition or dispatch failure passes. Have the stub record invocation per runner and assert that marker for capable runners, while asserting exit 2 and no invocation for incompatible runners.
🟠 [intake-fixtures-incomplete] MUST-FIX The required standing-pin path is not exercised: `sPin` merely repeats `override_admitted_seats`, and `assertAdmitted` only requires one claim call rather than an admitted intake result. This leaves standing-pin precedence and blind-capable admission vulnerable to false-green tests. Create a genuine pin-store-backed fixture, provide valid claim inputs/adapters, and assert admitted status plus the required mission/generation call counts for cc-shim and claude-native.
